rule.statement: A court is entitled to set aside a judgment if the parties have been prejudiced by the delay in prosecuting the case.
rule.supporting_quote: This I observe is an instance as aptly quoted by Wood Renton CJ in Supramanium Vs Symons 18 NLR 229 (referred to above), wherein he stated that no Judge is obliged or entitled to allow the accumulation upon is cause list of a mass of inanimate or semi animate actions.
